105.name: Grass Carp
notes: Stocked for weed control; it is illegal to take, harm or kill grass carp in public waters — release immediately.
105.auditQuote: It is unlawful to take, harm, or kill grass carp or robust redhorse from public waters. Any grass carp or robust redhorse taken must be returned immediately to the water from which it was taken.

106.name: Robust Redhorse
notes: Protected sucker species — release immediately where caught.
106.auditQuote: It is unlawful to take, harm, or kill grass carp or robust redhorse from public waters. Any grass carp or robust redhorse taken must be returned immediately to the water from which it was taken.

107.name: Sturgeon (Atlantic & Shortnose)
notes: Both sturgeon species are protected — release immediately in the water where caught. Also federally listed under the Endangered Species Act.
107.auditQuote: It is unlawful to buy, sell, possess or ship Shortnose Sturgeon and Atlantic Sturgeon.

108.name: Horseshoe Crab
notes: Recreational harvest or possession of live horseshoe crabs is prohibited; empty molted shells are fine.
108.auditQuote: Harvest and possession of horseshoe crabs is prohibited without a commercial permit. A permit is not required to possess a castoff or molted shell of a horseshoe crab.

109.name: Freshwater Mussels (native)
notes: Native freshwater mussels are off-limits without a permit; the small non-native Asian clam (Corbicula) may be taken.
109.auditQuote: Native freshwater mussels may not be taken without a permit from SCDNR. The non-native Asian clams, also known as Corbicula may be taken. Contact the Freshwater Fisheries Section at (803) 734-3891 for permits.
